title: Heshima, Adabu na Vyeo (Theme 4: Misimu)
status: draft: written 18 Nov 2026 offline for Grade 6 Kiswahili; not yet checked by a native Kiswahili teacher; not loaded by the live tutor

skills.key_step: The child uses the right respectful word or title for the person and the number (Shikamoo/Shikamooni, Bwana Chifu, Mheshimiwa).
representations: a role play of a visit to an office
a greeting chart for one and many
steps: Who is it, and how many?
What title or word of respect?
contexts: seasons (misimu): a farmers' meeting with the chief

board.do: Wait for the child to answer before saying anything.
The child greets one and then two elders, and an official by title.

misconceptions.ask: Soma tena: "Ukimwomba mwalimu kalamu unasema, "Mwalimu, nipe kalamu, ___."" Kwa nini "asante" si jibu sahihi?
misconceptions.repair: Tafadhali ni kuomba, asante ni kushukuru, samahani ni kuomba msamaha, pole ni kufariji, karibu ni kukaribisha.

misconceptions.ask: Soma tena: "Ni sentensi ipi ina heshima zaidi?" Kwa nini "Nisaidie kubeba mzigo huu!" si jibu sahihi?
misconceptions.repair: Ombi la heshima lina maneno kama tafadhali, naomba, samahani na asante.
Tumia cheo sahihi: Bwana Chifu, Mheshimiwa, Daktari.
